state.seed_assertion: The nature of processing in a DPIA should include details about data collection, storage, usage, access, sharing, processors, retention periods, security measures, new technologies, and novel processing types.

sentences.1: The nature of processing in a DPIA should include details about data collection, storage, usage, access, sharing, processors, retention periods, security measures, new technologies, and novel processing types.
sentences.2: The nature of the processing is what you plan to do with the personal data.
sentences.3: This should include, for example: how you collect the data;
sentences.6: who has access to the data;
sentences.7: who you share the data with;
sentences.9: Mitigating measures should include the source of each identified risk and options for reducing that risk such as limiting data collection, reducing processing scope, reducing retention periods, improving security, staff training, anonymisation, pseudonymisation, and data-sharing agreements.
sentences.10: A DPIA submission to the ICO must include descriptions of roles and responsibilities of joint controllers or processors, processing purposes and methods, protective measures and safeguards, DPO contact details, and a copy of the DPIA itself.
sentences.11: A well-written DPIA should explain why a DPIA was needed and detail the types of intended processing that made it a requirement.
sentences.12: You must include: a description of the respective roles and responsibilities of any joint controllers or processors;
